snippet.title: Super 10 Pin Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Strike your way through a wild world of bowling in Super 10 Pin! Explore a diverse range of unbelievable N64-styled bowling lanes, filled with curves, jumps, traps, obstacles and surprises! Watch your ball grow, fly through the air, and even explode as you master unique ball abilities to overcome any obstacle thrown your way.

Coming soon to Steam and Itch.io!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2383820/Super_10_Pin/
https://modus-interactive.itch.io/
